headline: Transfer rumors, news: Barcelona's Balde open to Man United move
description: Barcelona left back Alejandro Balde is ready to join Manchester United. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Morgan Rogers: Xabi Alonso 'could probably still play in the Premier League now'
description: New Chelsea signing Morgan Rogers said that Xabi Alonso "could probably still play in the Premier League" due to his ability to pass a ball in training.

headline: Arsenal want another Premier League title, but it won't come easy
description: Arsenal's Premier League title win was a triumph for Mikel Arteta & Co., but their desire to defend their crown will be a much tougher challenge. Just ask former title winners who fell short of a repeat.

headline: Brighton fan, 72, dies after falling ill after Aston Villa match
description: A Brighton fan has died after falling ill as he was leaving the stadium following their 4-0 win over Aston Villa, the club have confirmed.

headline: Brighton have red hot start to season with 4-0 win over Villa
description: Brighton's Maxim De Cuyper and Jack Hinshelwood doing the damage for Brighton as they opened up 4-0 lead after just 30 minutes to blow Aston Villa away.
